mapper.sql: id, goods_id, platform, caption, media_url, link_url, status, external_post_id, error, posted_by, deal_id, auto_active, add_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: insert into litemall_social_post (goods_id, platform, caption, media_url, link_url, status, external_post_id, error, posted_by, deal_id, auto_active, add_time, update_time, deleted) values (#{goodsId}, #{platform}, #{caption}, #{mediaUrl}, #{linkUrl}, #{status}, #{externalPostId}, #{error}, #{postedBy}, #{dealId}, #{autoActive}, #{addTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: select from litemall_social_post where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
mapper.update: update litemall_social_post set status = 'posted', external_post_id = #{externalPostId}, error = null, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and deleted = 0 and status in ('draft', 'failed')
update litemall_social_post set status = 'failed', error = #{error}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and deleted = 0 and status in ('draft', 'failed')
mapper.select: select from litemall_social_post where deleted = 0 and posted_by = 'auto' and auto_active = 1
mapper.update: update litemall_social_post set auto_active = 0, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and auto_active = 1
